conversations.title: Checking Photography Rules
conversations.description: Asking the staff if it is possible to take photos inside the church.

messages.text: Buongiorno. Posso aiutarla?
messages.english: Good morning. Can I help you?

choices.text: Buongiorno, posso fare delle foto qui?
choices.english: Good morning, can I take photos here?

choices.text: Buongiorno, dove posso comprare il pane?
choices.english: Good morning, where can I buy bread?
Good morning, how much does this pizza cost?

messages.text: Sì, ma senza flash, per favore. È vietato.
messages.english: Yes, but without flash, please. It is forbidden.

choices.text: Va bene, capisco. Niente flash allora.
choices.english: Alright, I understand. No flash then.

choices.text: Va bene, capisco. Voglio un caffè allora.
choices.english: Alright, I understand. I want a coffee then.

choices.text: Va bene, capisco. Dov'è la spiaggia allora?
choices.english: Alright, I understand. Where is the beach then?

messages.text: Esatto. Può scattare foto solo alle statue.
messages.english: Exactly. You can only take photos of the statues.

choices.english: Can I also take photos of the altar?
Can I also take photos of the hotel?
Can I also take photos of the car?

messages.text: No, l'altare è una zona sacra. Niente foto lì.
messages.english: No, the altar is a sacred area. No photos there.

choices.english: Thank you very much for the information.
Thank you very much for the reservation.
Thank you very much for the breakfast.

messages.text: Prego. Ricordi anche di restare in silenzio.
messages.english: You're welcome. Remember also to stay in silence.

choices.english: Certainly, I will respect the silence.
Certainly, I will drive the bus.
Certainly, I will buy a watch.

messages.text: Grazie. È importante per chi prega.
messages.english: Thank you. It is important for those who pray.

choices.english: I understand perfectly. Thanks again.
I understand perfectly. I want to leave.
I understand perfectly. Where is the bar?

messages.text: Le serve altro aiuto?
messages.english: Do you need any other help?

choices.english: Yes, I would like to see the dome.
Yes, I would like to see the mail.
Yes, I would like to see the suitcase.

messages.text: La cupola è aperta fino alle sei.
messages.english: The dome is open until six o'clock.

choices.english: Can I go up now?
Can I swim now?
Can I sleep now?

messages.text: Sì, ma deve fare il biglietto.
messages.english: Yes, but you must get a ticket.

choices.english: Alright, where is it bought?
Alright, where is it eaten?
Alright, where is it slept?

messages.text: Alla biglietteria vicino all'ingresso.
messages.english: At the ticket office near the entrance.

choices.english: Thank you, I'm going right away. Goodbye.
Thank you, I'm going to the cinema. Goodbye.
Thank you, I'm going to the bank. Goodbye.

conversations.title: Asking for Mass Times
conversations.description: Inquiring about the schedule for Sunday mass.

messages.text: Buongiorno, come posso aiutarla?
messages.english: Good morning, how can I help you?

choices.text: Buongiorno, vorrei sapere gli orari della messa.
choices.english: Good morning, I would like to know the mass times.

choices.text: Buongiorno, vorrei sapere gli orari dei treni.
choices.english: Good morning, I would like to know the train times.

choices.text: Buongiorno, vorrei sapere gli orari dei voli.
choices.english: Good morning, I would like to know the flight times.

messages.text: Per quale giorno le interessa?
messages.english: For which day are you interested?

choices.english: For Sunday morning, please.

choices.text: Per il mio compleanno, per favore.
choices.english: For my birthday, please.

choices.text: Per il prossimo anno, per favore.
choices.english: For next year, please.

messages.text: Domenica ci sono messe alle otto e alle dieci.
messages.english: Sunday there are masses at eight and at ten.

choices.text: C'è anche una celebrazione la sera?
choices.english: Is there also a celebration in the evening?

choices.text: C'è anche una colazione la sera?
choices.english: Is there also a breakfast in the evening?

choices.text: C'è anche una doccia la sera?
choices.english: Is there also a shower in the evening?

messages.text: Sì, l'ultima messa è alle diciannove.
messages.english: Yes, the last mass is at seven PM.

choices.english: Perfect, then I'll come at seven PM.
Perfect, then I'll go to the restaurant.
Perfect, then I'll buy a ticket.

messages.text: Benissimo. Arrivi qualche minuto prima.
messages.english: Very well. Arrive a few minutes early.

choices.text: Sì, certo. È necessario un biglietto?
choices.english: Yes, of course. Is a ticket necessary?

choices.text: Sì, certo. È necessario un ombrello?
choices.english: Yes, of course. Is an umbrella necessary?
choices.feedback: Depends on weather, but not context.

choices.text: Sì, certo. È necessario un passaporto?
choices.english: Yes, of course. Is a passport necessary?

messages.text: No, per la messa l'ingresso è libero.
messages.english: No, for the mass the entrance is free.

choices.english: Very well, thanks for the help.

choices.text: Molto bene, grazie per il vino.
choices.english: Very well, thanks for the wine.

choices.text: Molto bene, grazie per il taxi.
choices.english: Very well, thanks for the taxi.

messages.text: Di nulla. La chiesa è molto bella la sera.
messages.english: You're welcome. The church is very beautiful in the evening.

choices.text: Sì, ho sentito che è magnifica.
choices.english: Yes, I heard it is magnificent.

choices.text: Sì, ho sentito che è pericolosa.
choices.english: Yes, I heard it is dangerous.

choices.text: Sì, ho sentito che è chiusa.
choices.english: Yes, I heard it is closed.

messages.text: Vero. Soprattutto l'altare maggiore.
messages.english: True. Especially the main altar.

choices.english: I can't wait to visit it.
I can't wait to eat.
I can't wait to sleep.

messages.text: Le serve sapere altro?
messages.english: Do you need to know anything else?

choices.english: No, thanks. Everything is clear.
No, thanks. Everything is dirty.
No, thanks. Everything is broken.

messages.text: Arrivederci allora, a domenica.
messages.english: Goodbye then, see you Sunday.

choices.english: Goodbye and have a good day.
Goodbye and have a good trip.
Goodbye and enjoy your meal.

conversations.title: Guided Tour Inquiry
conversations.description: Asking about the availability and cost of guided tours for the cathedral.

messages.text: Salve! Desidera partecipare a un tour?
messages.english: Hello! Would you like to participate in a tour?

choices.text: Sì, ci sono delle visite guidate?
choices.english: Yes, are there any guided visits?

choices.text: Sì, ci sono delle pizze calde?
choices.english: Yes, are there any hot pizzas?

choices.text: Sì, ci sono delle camere libere?
choices.english: Yes, are there any free rooms?

messages.text: Sì, ne inizia una tra dieci minuti.
messages.english: Yes, one starts in ten minutes.

choices.english: Great. How much does the tour cost?
Great. How much does the taxi cost?
Great. How much does the milk cost?

messages.text: Il costo è di cinque euro a persona.
messages.english: The cost is five euros per person.

choices.english: Alright, I would like two tickets.
Alright, I would like two oranges.
Alright, I would like two suitcases.

messages.text: Ecco a lei. La guida vi aspetta all'ingresso.
messages.english: Here you go. The guide is waiting for you at the entrance.

choices.english: Does the guide also speak English?
Does the guide also speak Chinese?
Does the guide also talk too much?

messages.text: Sì, è un tour bilingue, italiano e inglese.
messages.english: Yes, it is a bilingual tour, Italian and English.

choices.english: Perfect, that works for us.
Perfect, for us it is expensive.
Perfect, for us it is late.

messages.text: Quanto dura la visita guidata?
messages.english: How long does the guided visit last?

choices.english: It lasts about an hour and a half.
It lasts about only one minute.
It lasts about a whole year.

messages.text: Si visitano anche le cappelle laterali?
messages.english: Are the side chapels also visited?

choices.text: Sì, il tour include tutto l'interno.
choices.english: Yes, the tour includes the whole interior.

choices.text: Sì, il tour include il pranzo.
choices.english: Yes, the tour includes lunch.

choices.text: Sì, il tour include il volo.
choices.english: Yes, the tour includes the flight.

messages.text: Possiamo vedere anche la cripta?
messages.english: Can we also see the crypt?

choices.text: Sì, la cripta è l'ultima tappa.
choices.english: Yes, the crypt is the last stop.

choices.text: Sì, la cripta è l'ultima spiaggia.
choices.english: Yes, the crypt is the last resort.

choices.text: Sì, la cripta è l'ultima cena.
choices.english: Yes, the crypt is the last supper.

messages.text: Molto interessante. Grazie mille.
messages.english: Very interesting. Thanks a lot.

choices.english: You're welcome, I hope you like it.
You're welcome, I hope it rains.
You're welcome, I hope it ends.

messages.text: Il tour sta per iniziare. Andate pure.
messages.english: The tour is about to start. Go ahead.

choices.english: Thanks, have a good day!
Thanks, good night!
Thanks, Merry Christmas!

conversations.title: Dress Code Clarification
conversations.description: Checking if the current clothing is appropriate for entering the church.

messages.text: Scusi, un momento per favore.
messages.english: Excuse me, one moment please.

choices.english: Yes? Is there some problem?
Yes? Is there some cat?
Yes? Is there some train?

messages.text: Per entrare servono vestiti appropriati.
messages.english: To enter, appropriate clothes are needed.

choices.text: Oh, i miei pantaloni sono troppo corti?
choices.english: Oh, are my pants too short?

choices.text: Oh, i miei capelli sono troppo lunghi?
choices.english: Oh, is my hair too long?

choices.text: Oh, i miei occhi sono troppo blu?
choices.english: Oh, are my eyes too blue?

messages.text: Sì, deve coprire le gambe e le spalle.
messages.english: Yes, you must cover your legs and shoulders.

choices.text: Posso usare questo scialle per le spalle?
choices.english: Can I use this shawl for my shoulders?

choices.text: Posso usare questo sapone per le spalle?
choices.english: Can I use this soap for my shoulders?

choices.text: Posso usare questo tavolo per le spalle?
choices.english: Can I use this table for my shoulders?

messages.text: Lo scialle va bene, ma i pantaloni no.
messages.english: The shawl is fine, but the pants are not.

choices.english: Do you have any wraps at the entrance?
Do you have any dogs at the entrance?
Do you have any books at the entrance?

messages.text: Sì, può prenderne uno gratuitamente.
messages.english: Yes, you can take one for free.

choices.english: Thanks, I'll put it on right away.
Thanks, I'll eat it right away.
Thanks, I'll drive it right away.

messages.text: Perfetto. Ora può entrare.
messages.english: Perfect. Now you can enter.

choices.english: Is it necessary to take off the hat?
Is it necessary to take off the shoes?
Is it necessary to take off the nose?

messages.text: Sì, per gli uomini è obbligatorio.
messages.english: Yes, for men it is mandatory.

choices.english: Alright, I'll take it off right away.
Alright, I'll buy it right away.
Alright, I'll wash it right away.

messages.text: Grazie per la collaborazione.
messages.english: Thank you for the cooperation.

choices.english: No problem, I respect the rules.
No problem, I break the rules.
No problem, I forget the rules.

messages.text: Le auguro una buona visita.
messages.english: I wish you a good visit.

choices.english: Thank you very much, good day.
Thank you very much, good trip.
Thank you very much, enjoy your meal.

messages.text: Arrivederci.
messages.english: Goodbye.

choices.english: Goodbye.
Please.
Excuse me.
